description: The messages of a long map: the text of its start and its end, which states where its work runs, the line that a host prints with a timestamp and a caller, and the engine of the work.

cases.description: A map of a table whose typed function has its body in Rust runs in Rust.

expect.text: r8map(): pkgr::spread over 10 columns and 100,000 groups, 1,000,000 calls, in Rust
expect.line: 2026-11-27 10:04:12 r8map(): pkgr::spread over 10 columns and 100,000 groups, 1,000,000 calls, in Rust [r8map]

cases.description: A body in the host's language runs in the host; the end states the wall time, the CPU time, and the threads.

expect.text: r8map(): done in 3.3 s, CPU 3.2 s of 1 thread, in Rust, with the body of `pkgr::spread_r` in R
expect.line: 2026-11-27 10:04:15 r8map(): done in 3.3 s, CPU 3.2 s of 1 thread, in Rust, with the body of `pkgr::spread_r` in R [r8map]

cases.description: A map of a list runs in the host, which calls each body.

expect.text: r8map(): pkgr::fit over 1 item, in R
expect.line: 2026-11-27 10:04:12 r8map(): pkgr::fit over 1 item, in R

cases.description: Compiled bodies of a list map run in Rust, from the host's loop.
